text:
Perfect! I have successfully updated all pricing information across your application. Here's a summary of the changes made:

## ✅ Pricing Update Complete

### New Pricing Structure:
- **Starter Plan**: $9.99 per birthday party (was $0)
- **Plus Plan**: $19.99 per birthday party (was $14.99) 
- **Pro Plan**: $29.99 per birthday party (unchanged)

### Files Updated:

1. **`/app/pricing/page.tsx`**
   - Updated all pricing displays to new amounts
   - Changed billing description from "one-time" to "per party"
   - Updated FAQ question and answer about pricing model
   - Changed badge text to "Pay per party. No monthly subscriptions"

2. **`/app/page.tsx`** (Home Page)
   - Updated pricing cards to show $9.99, $19.99, $29.99
   - Changed billing period text from "Introductory Offer" and "One-Time" to "per party"
   - Updated badge and description text

3. **`/app/account/page.tsx`**
   - Updated plan details pricing display
   - Updated badge showing Plus plan price

4. **`/app/terms/page.tsx`**
   - Updated Starter plan description
   - Changed billing description from "annually" to "per party"

5. **`/contexts/SubscriptionContext.tsx`**
   - Already had correct pricing structure (no changes needed)

### Key Changes:
- **Pricing Model**: Changed from one-time payments to per-party billing
- **Starter Plan**: Now $9.99 (no longer free/introductory)
- **Plus Plan**: Increased to $19.99 per party
- **Pro Plan**: Remains at $29.99 per party
- **Messaging**: Updated all references to reflect per-party billing instead of one-time or annual payments

The pricing is now consistently displayed across your entire application with the new per-party model!
